title: kith-attach: hex_encode per-byte format\! causes 32 intermediate String allocations
description: hex_encode (kith-attach/src/lib.rs line 244) iterates bytes and calls format\!('{:02x}', b) per byte, producing 32 String allocations then collect into one. Should use a pre-allocated String with a write macro or the hex crate. Low frequency (one call per blob ID generation) but unnecessary.
